title: Tanvi Sharma Advances to Korea Masters Second Round
indian_angle: India's rising star Tanvi Sharma continued her strong form by winning her opening match at the Korea Masters.
summary: Fresh off her Taipei Open title, Tanvi Sharma beat China’s Yuan An Qi in the Korea Masters opening round to set up an all-Indian clash with Shriyanshi Valishetty.

title: Kidambi Srikanth Crashes Out of Korea Masters First Round
indian_angle: Former world No. 1 Kidambi Srikanth suffered an early exit from the Korea Masters, losing in the first round.
summary: Kidambi Srikanth bowed out of the Korea Masters 2026 after losing 22-20, 14-21, 21-12 to Israel’s Daniil Dubovenko in the men’s singles first round.

title: Sindhu, Lakshya Get Favourable World Championships Openers; Ayush Faces Top Seed
indian_angle: Indian badminton stars PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen received relatively easy first-round draws for the upcoming BWF World Championships, while Ayush Shetty faces a tough challenge against the defending champion.
summary: Lakshya Sen faces Collins Filimon and PV Sindhu takes on Sophia Nobel in the first round of the New Delhi BWF World Championships starting Aug 17. Fifth-seed pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty receive a bye. Ayush Shetty is set to face defending champion Shi Yuqi.

title: Coach Tan Kim Her Concerned About Satwiksairaj Rankireddy's Shoulder Ahead of Worlds
indian_angle: National doubles coach Tan Kim Her expressed concern over Satwiksairaj Rankireddy's shoulder, a key factor as the star pair prepares to lead India's campaign at the upcoming World Championships.
summary: Returning to action following a planned break and physical rehab, the doubles pairing of Satwik and Chirag will anchor the home campaign at the Worlds, but coach Tan Kim Her highlights Satwik's shoulder as a main concern.

title: PV Sindhu Inaugurates Multi-Sport Centre for Sports Excellence in Visakhapatnam
indian_angle: Indian badminton icon P.V. Sindhu launched a Centre for Sports Excellence in Visakhapatnam, initially focused on badminton but now expanded to seven disciplines, showcasing her commitment to Indian sports development.
summary: What began as an initiative focused solely on badminton expanded into a multi-sport project following discussions with Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu and will now cater to seven disciplines.

title: Sindhu 9th Seed, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty 5th at Worlds
indian_angle: India's top players, PV Sindhu and the men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, have received their seeding for the upcoming BWF World Championships.
summary: PV Sindhu was seeded ninth in the women's singles for the upcoming BWF World Championships, while the pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty were seeded fifth.
